description: This Java source file defines the IntegrationModulesLoader class, responsible for loading and parsing integration module configuration data from a JSON file. It reads JSON resources, maps JSON structures to Java objects, and constructs IntegrationModule instances with detailed configurations.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: Main utility class for loading and parsing integration modules from JSON configuration files.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Loads a list of IntegrationModule objects from a specified JSON file path, reading the resource stream and parsing JSON content.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Parses a Map representing a module's JSON data into an IntegrationModule object, handling various configuration fields and nested structures.
